description: The Utility Rate Database (URDB) on OpenEI is a free store of electricity rate structure information maintained by the National Laboratory of the Rockies (formerly NREL). Contents: rate structures for US utilities, based on the Energy Information Administration's authoritative list of US utility companies; the OpenEI description counts more than 3,700 US utilities, with a subset checked and updated each year and each record showing its last update. A separate international database covers rates by country. Producer: NLR, hosted on OpenEI with DOE support. Coverage: United States utilities, plus international rates. Format and access: web browsing by utility, zip code or country, a computer-readable API, and bulk downloads of the US file (usurdb.csv.gz, usurdb.json.gz) and the international file (iurdb). Licence: OpenEI content is available under Creative Commons Zero unless otherwise noted (page footer). Caveats: only part of the database is re-verified annually, so older records may be out of date. Simulation uses: tariff inputs for distributed energy, storage and EV charging economics, demand response and customer bill models. Related records: data-eia-861-annual-electric-power-industry-report and model-reopt-jl.
